y-m-60-08.title: Wanne daga tsare-tsaren tanadin kuɗi biyu ne ya fi amfani?
y-m-60-08.topic: Kwatanta haɓakar jerin lissafi da na ninkawa: zaɓin da ke sauyawa bisa tsawon lokaci
y-m-60-08.goal: Kwatanta shiri mai ƙaruwa da tsayayyen adadi a kowace shekara da mai ƙaruwa da tsayayyen kaso; koyi cewa wanda ya fi kyau ya danganta da tsawon lokaci, sannan ka ba mutane a yanayi mabambanta shawara tare da bayyana zato.
y-m-60-08.material: Akwai tsare-tsaren tanadi biyu da suka fara da 100만 원. Shiri A yana ƙaruwa da 10만 원 a ƙarshen kowace shekara. Shiri B yana ƙaruwa da 5% na adadin shekarar da ta gabata a ƙarshen kowace shekara (adadin bayan shekara n shi ne 100 × 1.05ⁿ 만 원). Kada a yi la’akari da haraji, farashi, ko cire kuɗi da wuri. n shi ne adadin shekarun da suka wuce. (Yadda ake karantawa: 1.05ⁿ “1.05 to the n-th power” ne.)
y-m-60-08.thinking.0: Kwatanta yadda waɗannan samfuran biyu suke ƙaruwa
y-m-60-08.thinking.2: Rubuta shawarar da ta dace da mutumin bisa sharadi
y-m-60-08.prereq.0: Ka'ida ta gaba ɗaya ta jerin lissafi aₙ = a + (n−1)d, da ta jerin geometric aₙ = a·rⁿ⁻¹
y-m-60-08.prereq.1: Lissafin ƙarfin lamba (ta amfani da kalkuleta)
y-m-60-08.s.s1.prompt: Bayan shekaru 10, wane tsari ne ya fi kuɗi? Yi lissafin kowanne sannan ka zaɓa.
y-m-60-08.s.s1.hint.0: Lissafa adadin kuɗin bayan shekara 1 da bayan shekaru 2 ga kowane tsari.
y-m-60-08.s.s1.hint.1: Lissafa adadin kuɗin bayan shekaru 10 ga kowanne, sannan ka kwatanta.
y-m-60-08.s.s1.o.a: B ya fi yawa. Tsarin da yake ƙaruwa bisa ƙima yana ƙaruwa da sauri tun daga farko.
y-m-60-08.s.s1.r.a: Lissafa adadin kuɗin bayan shekara 1 da shekaru 2 ga tsare-tsaren biyu, sannan ka fara duba wanda ya fi yawa.
y-m-60-08.s.s1.o.b: Sun yi kusan daidai. Bayan shekaru 10, adadin kuɗin tsare-tsaren biyu ya kusan zama ɗaya.
y-m-60-08.s.s1.r.b: Lissafa adadin kuɗin bayan shekaru 10 ga kowanne, sannan ka kwatanta. Yi amfani da kalkuleta don gano 100 × 1.05¹⁰.
y-m-60-08.s.s1.o.c: A ya fi yawa. A yanzu, tsarin da yake ƙaruwa da ƙayyadadden adadi a kowace shekara ne ke gaba.
y-m-60-08.s.s1.o.d: Babu isasshen bayani. Ko da yake adadin farko ɗaya ne, muna buƙatar ƙarin bayani.
y-m-60-08.s.s1.r.d: An riga an bayar da duk bayanan da ake buƙata. Saka su cikin ƙa'idodin sannan ka lissafa.
y-m-60-08.s.s1.explain: Bayan shekaru 10, A = 100 + 10 × 10 = 200万 원, B kuma = 100 × 1.05¹⁰ ≈ 162.9만 원, saboda haka A ya fi yawa. Bayan shekara 1 ma, A = 110, B = 105, don haka A ne ke gaba. Tsarin da yake ƙaruwa bisa ƙima ba ya kasancewa gaba tun daga farko.
y-m-60-08.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ka rubuta shekaru n guda uku daban-daban da B ke da kuɗi fiye da A. (Bayan shekaru n, A = 100 + 10n, B kuma = 100 × 1.05ⁿ만 원. Za ka iya amfani da kalkuleta.)
y-m-60-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ƙara n da 10 a kowane mataki, lissafa adadin biyun, sannan ka ga yadda tazarar ke sauyawa.
y-m-60-08.s.s2.hint.1: Kusa da ƙimar farko ta n da B ya fi A, duba ta hanyar sauya n da 1 a kowane mataki.
y-m-60-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Bayan shekaru n, B ya fi A.
y-m-60-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Bayan shekaru n, B bai fi A ba. Ƙara n, sannan ka sake lissafa adadin biyun.
y-m-60-08.s.s2.explain: Idan n=27, to B ≈ 373.3만 원, A = 370만 원, saboda haka B ya fara yin gaba a karon farko. Idan n=26, B ≈ 355.5만 원, A = 360만 원, don haka A har yanzu ya fi yawa. Idan n ya kai 27 ko fiye, B zai ci gaba da fin A. Idan n=40, B ≈ 704만 원, A = 500만 원.
y-m-60-08.s.s3.prompt: Haeun tana son tara kuɗin da za ta yi amfani da shi bayan shekaru 12, Doyun kuma yana son tara kuɗin da zai yi amfani da shi bayan shekaru 40. Ka rubuta jimla ɗaya ko biyu ga kowannensu, kana bayyana ko za ka ba da shawarar A ko B da dalilanka. (Ka kuma bayyana cewa ba a la'akari da haraji da farashi.)
y-m-60-08.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta adadin A da B bayan shekaru 12 da 40, ka kwatanta su, sannan ka rubuta amsarka.
y-m-60-08.s.s3.hint.1: Saka lokacin juyawa da ka gano yanzu (shekarar da B zai fara yin gaba) a cikin dalilin shawarar.
y-m-60-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shawarar da ka ba Haeun da Doyun ta bambanta? Shin dalilin ya dogara da sakamakon lissafi (misali, B ya fara gaba daga shekara ta 27)?
y-m-60-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana zato (ba a la'akari da haraji da farashi, kuma ƙimar riba ba ta sauyawa)?
y-m-60-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka guji kalamai kamar 'B ya fi kyau kullum' ko 'A ya fi kyau kullum' waɗanda ba su kula da tsawon lokacin ba?
y-m-60-08.s.s3.model.0: Ina ba Haeun shawarar A domin za ta yi amfani da kuɗin bayan shekaru 12. Bayan shekaru 12, A = 220만 원, B kuma kusan 180만 원 ne. Ina ba Doyun shawarar B domin bayan shekaru 40, B kusan 704만 원 ne, wanda ya fi 500만 원 na A. Ban yi la'akari da haraji da farashi ba.
y-m-60-08.s.s3.model.1: A ne ke gaba na ɗan lokaci, B kuma ke gaba na dogon lokaci. Dalili kuwa shi ne A ya fi yawa har zuwa shekara ta 26, B kuma ya fi yawa daga shekara ta 27. Saboda haka zan gaya wa Haeun, wadda za ta jira shekaru 12, cewa A ya fi kyau, Doyun mai shekaru 40 kuma B ya fi kyau. Amma na ɗauka cewa ƙimar riba ba ta sauyawa.
y-m-60-08.s.s3.modelNote.1: An yi amfani da lokacin juyawa a shekara ta 27 a matsayin hujja, ba tare da takamaiman adadi ba.

y-m-60-03.title: Nawa daga cikin lambobin kimantawa za mu iya amincewa da su?
y-m-60-03.topic: Kimanta logarithm na goma da adadin lambobi: har yaushe za a amince da ƙiyasin?
y-m-60-03.goal: Ka koyi cewa ƙaramin kuskuren ƙiyasin na iya canza ƙarshe idan n ya yi girma; nemo yanayin da ƙarshe ya bambanta, sannan ka bayyana sharuddan dogaro da ƙiyasin.
y-m-60-03.material: Muna son gano adadin lambobin 2ⁿ. Adadin lambobin cikakkiyar lamba tabbatacciya N shi ne (ɓangaren cikakkiya na log N)+1, saboda haka na 2ⁿ shi ne (ɓangaren cikakkiya na n×log 2)+1. Ainihin log 2=0.30102999566…, amma Soyoung ta yi amfani da 0.301, ta ƙara 1 ga ɓangaren cikakkiya na n×0.301. (ɓangaren cikakkiya ita ce lambar kafin alamar goma. Misali, na 9.03 shi ne 9.)
y-m-60-03.thinking.0: Yi la’akari da tasirin kuskure ga ƙarshe
y-m-60-03.thinking.1: Nemo da kanka yanayin da ƙarshe ya bambanta
y-m-60-03.thinking.2: Bayyana sharuɗɗan da za a iya dogaro da ƙiyasin
y-m-60-03.prereq.0: Dangantakar logarithm na goma da adadin lambobi (na tabbatacciyar N, ɓangaren cikakkiya na log N da aka ƙara 1)
y-m-60-03.prereq.1: Gaskiyar cewa log 2 kusan 0.301 ne da amfani da kalkuleta
y-m-60-03.prereq.2: Matakin wahalar aikin H3 ne, ba ajin makaranta ba; an ɗauka ka kammala darasin logarithm na goma.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.prompt: Ga n=30, Soyoung ta ce 30×0.301=9.03, saboda haka 2³⁰ yana da lambobi 10. Za mu iya amincewa da wannan ƙarshe? Ninka 30 da ainihin ƙimar 0.30102999566…, kwatanta, sannan ka zaɓa.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta ninkin 30 da ƙiyasin na sau 30 da ninkin ainihin ƙima gefe da gefe, zuwa wuraren goma huɗu.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta bambancin ƙimomin biyu da nisan ƙimar da aka lissafa zuwa cikakkiyar lamba mafi kusa.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.o.a: An yi amfani da ƙiyasin, don haka akwai kuskure; ba za a san adadin lambobi ba sai an lissafa ainihin ƙima
y-m-60-03.s.s1.r.a: An riga an bayar da ainihin ƙimar, don haka kwatanta ninkin biyun domin sanin kuskuren. Ka tantance ko ya isa ya canza ƙarshe.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.o.b: 9.03 tana da nisa daga 9 fiye da kuskuren (ƙasa da 0.001), don haka ƙarshe na lambobi 10 ya tabbata
y-m-60-03.s.s1.o.c: Ƙiyasin ya fi ainihin ƙima ƙanƙanta, saboda haka ainihin adadin lambobi koyaushe ya ƙara 1 daga wanda aka samo da ƙiyasin
y-m-60-03.s.s1.r.c: Ƙima kaɗan ƙarama ba lallai ta canza ɓangaren cikakkiya ba. Ka yi tunanin abin da ya kamata ya faru domin ya canza.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.o.d: 0.301 da ainihin ƙima sun yi daidai har zuwa wurin goma na uku, don haka adadin lambobi iri ɗaya ne ga kowace n
y-m-60-03.s.s1.r.d: Kuskure yana ninku sau n idan an ninka ƙima da n. Kwatanta n=30 da n mai girma sosai.
y-m-60-03.s.s1.explain: 30×0.30102999566…=9.0309… kuma 30×0.301=9.03; bambancin bai kai 0.001 ba. Ƙimomin biyun suna tsakanin 9 da 10, ɓangaren cikakkiyarsu 9 ne, saboda haka 2³⁰ lamba ce mai lambobi 10 (2³⁰=1073741824). Dogaro da ƙiyasin ya danganta da girman kuskure da nisan ƙimar lissafi daga cikakkiyar lamba.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ka shigar da lambobin halitta n biyu daban inda adadin lambobin 2ⁿ da aka samo da hanyar Soyoung (0.301) da ainihin ƙima (0.30102999566…) suka bambanta. (Adadin lambobi=ɓangaren cikakkiya na n×log 2+1)
y-m-60-03.s.s2.hint.0: Lissafta wasu n, ka nemo inda ɓangaren goma na n×0.301 yake kusa sosai da 1.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.hint.1: Lissafta wasu ƙimomi domin ganin yadda bambancin n×0.301 da n×(ainihin ƙima) ke canzawa idan n ya ƙaru.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.fail.c1: n dole ya zama lambar halitta 1 ko fiye.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Adadin lambobin da hanyoyin biyu suka samu ya bambanta.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Adadin lambobin da hanyoyin biyun suka samu ɗaya ne. Kwatanta ɓangarorin cikakkiya na n×0.301 da n×0.30102999566.
y-m-60-03.s.s2.explain: Idan n=196, 196×0.301=58.996, ɓangaren cikakkiya 58 ne, saboda haka ana cewa lambobi 59 ne; amma da ainihin ƙima, 196×0.30102999566…=59.0018…, ɓangaren cikakkiya 59 ne, kuma 2¹⁹⁶ yana da lambobi 60. Haka yake ga n=299 (lambobi 91) da n=392 (lambobi 119). Idan ƙimar lissafi tana ƙasa da cikakkiyar lamba kaɗan, ƙaramin kuskure na iya sa ta ketare ko ta kasa ketarawa, ƙarshe kuma ya canza.
y-m-60-03.s.s3.prompt: Mun amince da ƙiyasin ga n=30, amma ba ga n ɗin da ka gano yanzu ba. A jimloli ɗaya ko biyu, bayyana abin da ke bambanta yanayin da za a iya amincewa da adadin lambobin da aka samo ta 0.301 da wanda ba za a amince da shi ba.
y-m-60-03.s.s3.hint.0: Ga n=30 da n=196, rubuta nisan n×0.301 daga cikakkiyar lamba mafi kusa.
y-m-60-03.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta wannan tazara da n×(ainihin ƙima − 0.301).
y-m-60-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka ce kuskuren yana ƙaruwa tare da n?
y-m-60-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka ce yana da haɗari idan ƙimar da aka lissafa tana kusa da ƙasa (ko sama da) cikakken lamba?
y-m-60-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka duba abin da ka faɗa da n ɗin da ka samu (misali, 196) ko da lissafin n=30?
y-m-60-03.s.s3.model.0: Ana ninka kuskuren kusantar da n, saboda haka yayin da n ya fi girma, kuskuren ma ya fi girma. Don haka idan n×0.301 yana kusa sosai da cikakken lamba, kuskuren na iya sa ya ƙetare ko bai ƙetare lambar ba, ya canza adadin lambobi; idan yana nesa da cikakken lamba, za ka iya amincewa da shi.
y-m-60-03.s.s3.model.1: Idan ƙimar da aka lissafa 9.03 tana nesa da cikakken lamba, kamar na 30, ɓangaren lamba ba ya canzawa ko da kuskuren (kimanin 0.001). Idan ƙimar 58.996 tana kusa sosai da 59, kamar na 196, ƙaramin bambanci yana canza adadin lambobi.
y-m-60-03.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ba a ce kuskuren yana ƙaruwa da n ba, amma an gano muhimmin batu ta hanyar kwatanta tazarar zuwa cikakken lamba da kuskuren.

y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ta yaya waɗannan bayanai suka sauya hukuncinka?
y-m-60-05.title: Juyawar matakin teku: me bayanan za su iya gaya mana?
y-m-60-05.topic: Zangon aikin sine: iya tantance zangon aiki daga ma’aunai da aka ɗauka a tazarar lokaci-lokaci
y-m-60-05.goal: Koyi cewa bayanan da aka auna a tazara mai faɗi ba za su tantance zangon aiki ba; daidaita hukuncinka yayin da sababbin bayanai ke zuwa, sannan ka kwatanta samfuran da za su yiwu kai tsaye da ma’aunai.
y-m-60-05.material: Muna son auna matakin ruwa (m) a tashar jiragen ruwa, mu bayyana shi da dabarar h(t) = 3 + 2·sin(2πt/T). t shi ne lokacin (a sa’o’i) tun daga ƙarfe 0, kuma T shi ne zangon aiki (a sa’o’i). An zagaye ma’aunai zuwa raka’ar 0.1 m kuma suna iya karkacewa da kusan ±0.2 m saboda raƙuman ruwa. Manufar ita ce tantance T. (Yadda ake karantawa: 2πt/T “2π t over T” ne.)
y-m-60-05.thinking.0: Yi la’akari da iyakar bayanan (tazarar ma’auni)
y-m-60-05.thinking.1: Daidaita hukunci da tabbaci gwargwadon sababbin bayanai
y-m-60-05.thinking.2: Kwatanta samfuran da za su yiwu da ma’aunai
y-m-60-05.prereq.0: Zangon aiki 2π/b da faɗin aikin y = a·sin(bx) + c
y-m-60-05.prereq.1: Ƙimomin ayyukan trigonometri cikin radian (sanya kalkuleta a yanayin radian don lissafi)
y-m-60-05.prereq.2: Wannan matakin wahala ne na wannan aiki (H3), ba aikin ajin makaranta ba, kuma yana ɗauka cewa ka koyi jadawalin ayyukan trigonometri.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai a hankali, guda bayan guda. A kowane mataki, zaɓi hukuncin da ya fi dacewa.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, kwatanta waɗanne samfura daga cikin waɗanda ka ɗauka masu yiwuwa a baya ne sabon bayani ya kawar.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.hint.1: Zaɓi zangon aiki guda, ka lissafta tsayin a lokutan da aka bayyana da kanka, sannan ka gwada shi da ma’aunai.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Waɗannan ƙimomi ne da aka auna a tazarar sa’o’i 3. t=0: 3.0 m, t=3: 5.0 m, t=6: 3.2 m, t=9: 1.0 m. Idan T=12, dabarar tana ba da 3.0, 5.0, 3.0, 1.0 m bi da bi.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Da bayanan da ake da su yanzu, wane hukunci ne ya fi dacewa game da zangon aikin?
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.after: T=12 da T=2.4 suna ba da ƙimomi iri ɗaya a tazarar sa’o’i 3 (t=0, 3, 6, 9). Saboda haka daga waɗannan ƙimomi huɗu kaɗai, 12 yana da yiwuwa amma yana da wuya a tabbatar. Muna buƙatar ma’auni a tazara mafi kusa.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Zangon aikin sa’o’i 12 ne. Duk ƙimomi huɗun sun dace sosai da samfurin T=12
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ma’aunan da aka ɗauka a tazarar sa’o’i 3 na iya zama iri ɗaya ga gajerun zanguna ma. Misali, lissafta ƙimomin t=3, 6, 9 idan T=2.4.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Sa’o’i 12 yana da yiwuwa, amma gajerun zanguna ma suna yiwuwa, don haka ya yi wuri a tabbatar
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Zangon aikin sa’o’i 3 ne. Tun da an auna ƙimomin duk bayan sa’o’i 3, wannan tazarar ita ce zangon aikin
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ƙimomin sun bambanta: 3.0 a t=0 da 5.0 a t=3. Idan zangon aiki 3 ne, ƙima iri ɗaya ya kamata ta maimaitu.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Bayanan maki huɗu ne kawai, don haka ba za mu iya cewa komai game da zangon aikin ba
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ana iya rage yawan samfuran da za su yiwu. Ka yi tunanin waɗanne ne suka saɓa da bayanan.
y-m-60-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Mun sake aunawa a tazarar sa’a 1 daga t=0 zuwa 6: 3.0, 4.0, 4.7, 5.0, 4.8, 4.1, 3.2 m.

y-m-60-04.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci ko bayanin ya isa.
y-m-60-04.title: Idan sin θ = 3/5 ne, shin ana iya tantance cos θ ta hanya guda?
y-m-60-04.topic: Dangantakar ayyukan trigonometri: sharuddan tantance cos θ da tan θ idan an ba da sin θ
y-m-60-04.goal: Nuna, ta hanyar gano dukkan ƙimomin da za su yiwu, cewa ƙimar sine ita kaɗai ba ta tantance ƙimomin cosine da tangent ta hanya guda ba; sannan gano ƙarin bayani da zai kayyade ƙimomin.
y-m-60-04.material: Kusurwa θ kusurwa ce ta gama-gari (ba kome ko ana amfani da radian ko digiri) kuma sin θ = 3/5. Harin ta ce, “Tun da sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, cos θ = 4/5 kuma tan θ = 3/4.” (Yadda ake karantawa: sin θ “sine theta” ne, sin²θ “sine theta squared” ne, 3/5 kuma “three fifths” ne.)
y-m-60-04.thinking.1: Nemo dukkan yanayin da suka cika sharuddan
y-m-60-04.thinking.2: Gano ƙarin sharuddan da za su kayyade sakamakon
y-m-60-04.prereq.0: Ma’anar ayyukan trigonometri ga kusurwoyi na gama-gari da alamominsu a kowane kwata
y-m-60-04.prereq.2: Wannan matakin wahala ne na wannan aiki (H3), ba aikin ajin makaranta ba, kuma yana ɗauka cewa ka kammala sashen ayyukan trigonometri.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.prompt: Wane hukunci ne ya fi dacewa game da sakamakon Harin?
y-m-60-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo ƙimar cos²θ, sannan ka ƙidaya lambobi nawa ne idan aka ɗaga su murabba’i za su ba da wannan ƙima.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta kwata-kwatan da ke ɗauke da kusurwoyin da sin θ ɗinsu yake da kyau.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.a: Daidai ne. Daga sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, ana tantance cos θ = 4/5 da tan θ = 3/4
y-m-60-04.s.s1.r.a: Duba ko lamba guda ce kawai wadda murabba’inta yake 16/25.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.b: cos θ yana iya zama ƙimomi biyu, 4/5 da −4/5, amma ana ɗaukar tushen murabba’i mai kyau bisa ƙa’ida; saboda haka an tantance shi a matsayin 4/5
y-m-60-04.s.s1.r.b: Ƙa’idar ɗaukar tushe mai kyau ta shafi alamar tushen murabba’i. Duba ko kusurwar da cos θ ɗinta mara kyau ne za ta iya cika sin θ = 3/5.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.c: cos θ na iya zama 4/5 ko −4/5, saboda haka ba a tantance ƙima guda daga bayanin da aka bayar kawai ba
y-m-60-04.s.s1.o.d: Idan sin θ = 3/5, to dole θ ya kasance kusurwa a kwata na farko, don haka ƙimar Harin daidai ce
y-m-60-04.s.s1.r.d: Duba ko kusurwoyin da sin θ ɗinsu yake da kyau suna cikin kwata na farko kawai.
y-m-60-04.s.s1.explain: Tun da sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, cos²θ = 1 − 9/25 = 16/25, saboda haka cos θ = 4/5 ko −4/5. Idan sin θ>0, θ yana cikin kwata na farko ko na biyu, don haka duka biyun suna yiwuwa.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ka shigar da nau’i-nau’i biyu mabambanta masu yiwuwa na ƙimomi (cos θ, tan θ) ga kusurwar θ inda sin θ = 3/5. (Rubuta kaso a matsayin goma. Misali: 3/5 = 0.6)
y-m-60-04.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko nemo cos²θ, sannan nemo duk ƙimomin cos θ da ke ba da ita.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.hint.1: Ga kowace ƙimar cos θ, lissafta sin θ ÷ cos θ don nemo tan θ.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Ba sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 ba ne. sin²θ = 0.36. Duba abin da murabba’in cos θ ya kamata ya zama.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Ya cika tan θ = sin θ ÷ cos θ.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.fail.c2: tan θ × cos θ bai yi daidai da sin θ = 0.6 ba. Sake nemo tan θ.
y-m-60-04.s.s2.explain: Idan cos θ = 0.8, to tan θ = 0.6 ÷ 0.8 = 0.75; idan cos θ = −0.8, to tan θ = −0.75. Waɗannan su ne dukkan yiwuwar.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.prompt: Muna neman ƙarin bayani da zai zaɓa tsakanin yiwuwar biyun. Zaɓi duk bayanan da aka bayar a ƙasa waɗanda, idan aka haɗa su da sin θ = 3/5, za su tantance (cos θ, tan θ) ta hanya guda ko da an bayar da wannan kaɗai.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.hint.0: Saka ƙimomin biyun (0.8, 0.75) da (−0.8, −0.75) cikin sharadin kowanne zaɓi.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.hint.1: Ware zaɓuɓɓukan da ƙimomin biyun suka cika daga waɗanda ƙima guda kawai ta cika.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.r.b: Tsakanin 0 da π akwai kusurwoyi a kwata na farko da na biyu. Duba ko ƙimomin biyun duk suna nan.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.o.c: Gaskiyar cewa cos θ + sin θ < 1
y-m-60-04.s.s3.r.d: Idan sin θ>0 ne, an riga an sani. Duba ko sabon bayani ne.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.r.e: A cikin ƙimomin biyun, cos θ ba 0 ba ne. Duba ko zai iya bambance su.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.o.f: Gaskiyar cewa sin θ × cos θ > 0
y-m-60-04.s.s3.explain: Ƙimomin biyun su ne (0.8, 0.75) da (−0.8, −0.75). a: tan θ<0, na biyu kawai ya cika. c: cos θ + sin θ = 1.4 ga na farko kuma −0.2 ga na biyu, don haka na biyu kaɗai ya cika <1. f: sin θ × cos θ>0 yana nufin cos θ>0, saboda haka na farko kaɗai ya cika. b, d, da e ƙimomin biyun suna cikawa, don haka ba sa bambance su.
y-m-60-04.s.s3.o.d: Gaskiyar cewa θ kusurwa ce a kwata na farko ko na biyu

y-m-60-02.title: Shin exponent mafi girma koyaushe yana ba da ƙima mafi girma?
y-m-60-02.topic: Kwatanta exponent: yanayin da alkiblar rashin daidaito ta dogara da tushe
y-m-60-02.goal: Ka koyi cewa “duk misalan da na gwada sun yi aiki” ba isasshiyar hujja ba ce ga ƙa’ida ta gama-gari. Ƙirƙiri misali mai karo da ƙa’ida, sannan ka zaɓi sharuɗɗan da ake buƙata domin yanke ƙarshe.
y-m-60-02.material: Minji ta ce, “a tabbatacce ne, a≠1. Idan aᵐ<aⁿ, to m<n.” (m da n lambobi ne na gaske; aᵐ ana karanta shi “a zuwa ikon m”.) Ta gwada a=2, 2¹<2³, da a=3, 3²<3⁵; a duka m<n.
y-m-60-02.thinking.0: Kimanta yadda misalan suke wakiltar yanayi (wane zangon tushe aka gwada)
y-m-60-02.thinking.2: Zaɓi sharuɗɗan da ake buƙata domin ƙarshe
y-m-60-02.prereq.0: Ikon lambobi da dokokinsa (har da exponent marar kyau da sifili)
y-m-60-02.prereq.2: Wannan matakin wahala ne H3, ba sanya shi ga shekarar makaranta ba; an ɗauka ka kammala darasin exponent da logarithm.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.prompt: Daga misalan biyu da Minji ta gwada, wane bayani ne ya fi dacewa game da da’awarta?
y-m-60-02.s.s1.hint.0: Duba inda ƙimomin a da Minji ta gwada suka taru a cikin zangon yiwuwar a.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.hint.1: Zaɓi a daga zangon da ba a gwada ba, sannan ka lissafta aᵐ da aⁿ.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.a: Ya yi aiki sau biyu, da 2 da 3, saboda haka yana aiki ga kowane a
y-m-60-02.s.s1.r.a: Gwaji sau biyu ba hujja ba ce. Da farko duba zangon tushen da aka gwada.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.b: Ba za mu tabbata ba sai mun gwada yanayin da m da n lambobi ne na gaske amma ba cikakkun lambobi ba
y-m-60-02.s.s1.r.b: Matsalar ita ce zangon tushe a, ba zangon m da n ba. Sake duba ƙimomin a da aka gwada.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.c: Dukkan tushen da aka gwada sun fi 1; dole ne a gwada tushe ƙasa da 1 kafin tabbaci
y-m-60-02.s.s1.o.d: Misalan da suka yi aiki ba sa karyata da’awar; idan babu misalin karo da ƙa’ida, za mu iya karɓarta a matsayin gaskiya
y-m-60-02.s.s1.r.d: Rashin neman misalin karo da ƙa’ida ba yana nufin babu shi ba. Duba ƙimomin a da ba a gwada ba.
y-m-60-02.s.s1.explain: Tushen 2 da 3 duk sun fi 1. Tunda a na iya zama 0<a<1, ba za a ce “koyaushe” ba sai an gwada wannan yanayin. Zangon misalan da aka gwada yana ƙayyade ƙarfin shaida.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri ka shigar da (a,m,n) biyu masu tushe a daban inda aᵐ<aⁿ amma m>n. (a>0 kuma a≠1; za ka iya rubuta adadi goma.)
y-m-60-02.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi a ƙasa da 1, ka lissafta wasu ƙimomi domin ganin canjin aᵐ yayin da m ke ƙaruwa.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi wasu lambobin cikakke na m da n, lissafta a^m da a^n, sannan ka kwatanta.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a dole ya zama tabbatacce kuma ba 1 ba.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.fail.c2: m bai fi n ba. Zaɓi lambobi biyu inda m>n.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.fail.c3: aᵐ bai fi aⁿ ƙanƙanta ba. Lissafta ƙimomin biyu ka kwatanta.
y-m-60-02.s.s2.explain: Misali, a=0.5, m=3, n=1 yana ba da 0.5³=0.125<0.5¹=0.5 duk da m>n. Idan a=0.25, m=2, n=−1, muna samun 0.0625<4. Da’awar Minji ba ta aiki ga 0<a<1.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.prompt: Idan aᵐ<aⁿ, ban da sharadin a tabbatacce kuma a≠1, me ya kamata ka sani domin yanke m<n? Zaɓi duk sharuɗɗan da suka wadatar. (Gwada ta ƙirƙirar misalai masu karo da ƙa’ida.)
y-m-60-02.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, nemo (a,m,n) da ya cika sharadin amma har yanzu misali ne mai karo da ƙa’ida.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.hint.1: Duba ko zangon a da ya rage yana ƙunshe da ƙimomi ƙasa da 1.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.o.a: Gaskiyar cewa a lambar halitta ce
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.a: Idan a lambar halitta ce ban da 1, duba inda a ke farawa. Rubuta mafi ƙarancin ƙimarta.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.o.b: Gaskiyar cewa m da n dukansu tabbatattu ne
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.b: a=0.5, m=3, n=1 dukansu m da n tabbatattu ne, amma aᵐ<aⁿ yayin m>n.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.c: Idan a=0.7, m=3, n=1, muna samun 0.343<0.7 duk da m>n.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.d: Idan a>1, aˣ yana ƙaruwa ne kawai, saboda haka alkiblar rashin daidaito tana nan yadda take.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.o.e: Gaskiyar cewa a≠1 (sharadin da aka riga aka sani)
y-m-60-02.s.s3.r.e: Wannan sharadi mun riga mun sani, ba sabon bayani ba ne. Ba ya bambanta a>1 da 0<a<1.
y-m-60-02.s.s3.explain: Idan a>1, aˣ yana ƙaruwa, don haka aᵐ<aⁿ ⇒ m<n. Idan a lambar halitta ce ban da 1, a≥2 ne, saboda haka a>1 kuma sharadin ya wadatar. Ga b, c da e har yanzu a na iya zama 0<a<1, don haka misalin karo da ƙa’ida yana yiwuwa. Idan 0<a<1 aka sani, akasin haka m>n ne.

y-m-60-01.title: Mafita guda ɗaya kawai? A ina aka yi kuskure?
y-m-60-01.topic: Kaddarorin logarithm da sharadin argument: mafitar log₂(x²)=4
y-m-60-01.goal: Ka koyi cewa amfani da kaddarorin logarithm na iya canza zangon x da aka yarda, gano layin da mafita ta ɓace ka gyara shi, sannan ka zaɓi sauye-sauyen da ba sa canza zangon.
y-m-60-01.material: Suho ya warware log₂(x²)=4 (x lamba ce ta gaske marar sifili) kamar haka. (log₂ A: logarithm na A mai tushe 2; x²: x murabba’i.)
y-m-60-01.thinking.0: Duba ko kowanne layi yana aiki bisa sharadi iri ɗaya da layin baya
y-m-60-01.thinking.1: Gwada mafita ta saka su kai tsaye cikin lissafi
y-m-60-01.thinking.2: Kwatanta zangon da aka yarda kafin da bayan sauyi
y-m-60-01.prereq.0: Ma’ana da kaddarorin logarithm (argument tabbatacce ne, kuma log M^k=k·log M ana amfani da shi idan M>0)
y-m-60-01.prereq.1: Dangantakar lambobin da absolute value da murabba’insu suka yi daidai
y-m-60-01.prereq.2: Wannan matakin wahala ne H3, ba ajin makaranta ba; an ɗauka ka riga ka koyi kaddarorin exponent da logarithm.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi ɗaya a mafitar Suho inda kuskuren yake.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta ko kowanne layi yana aiki ga zangon x iri ɗaya da layin baya.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.hint.1: Saka wata x mara kyau cikin lissafin asali ka duba ko an ayyana shi.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka mafita guda ɗaya ita ce x=4.
y-m-60-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 ne kuskure. log₂x yana da ma’ana ne idan x>0, amma lissafin asali yana da ma’ana ko da x mara kyau ne, domin x² tabbatacce ne. Layi na 2 ya cire x<0, don haka “guda ɗaya kawai” a layi na 5 ƙarshe ne marar daidai. Layi na 5 ma kuskure ne. x=−4 ma yana ba da log₂16=4.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ka shigar da lambobi biyu daban na gaske x da suka cika log₂(x²)=4.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ta amfani da ma’anar logarithm, sake rubuta log₂A=4 a matsayin dangantaka tsakanin A da 2.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.hint.1: Saka x ɗin da ka samo cikin log₂(x²) na asali ka tabbatar sakamakon 4 ne.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Idan x=0, x²=0 ne, saboda haka argument na logarithm ba tabbatacce ba ne.
y-m-60-01.s.s2.fail.c2: log₂(x²) ba 4 ba ne. Ka sake tunani wane ikon 2 ke ba da x².
y-m-60-01.s.s2.explain: Bisa ma’anar logarithm, x²=2⁴=16, don haka x=4 ko −4. Dukansu suna cika lissafin asali, akwai mafita biyu.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.prompt: Sauyi kamar layi na 2 na Suho na iya canza zangon x. Zaɓi duk sauye-sauyen da “zangon ƙimar x iri ɗaya ne kafin da bayan.” (x lamba ce ta gaske.)
y-m-60-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, rubuta zangon x da ake buƙata domin abin cikin logarithm ya zama tabbatacce a bangarorin hagu da dama, sannan ka kwatanta.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.hint.1: Idan zangon ya bambanta, saka wata x mara kyau a bangarorin biyu.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.a: Bangaren dama yana aiki ne kawai idan x>0, amma na hagu yana buƙatar x≠0 kawai. Saka x=−4 a bangarorin biyun.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.b: Kwatanta sharadin x/3 ya zama tabbatacce da sharadin x ya zama tabbatacce.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.c: Bangaren hagu yana aiki idan x<0 ko x>2. Ka yi tunanin zangon da bangaren dama yake aiki.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.d: Bangaren hagu yana aiki idan x>0 kawai, na dama kuwa yana aiki ko da x mara kyau ne. Zangon ya faɗaɗa.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.r.e: Sharadin |x| ya zama tabbatacce daidai yake da x≠0. Duba ko x mara kyau yana ciki.
y-m-60-01.s.s3.explain: Ga b, x/3>0 ⇔ x>0, zangon ɗaya ne; ga e, |x|>0 ⇔ x≠0, zangon ma ɗaya ne. A cire x<0; a c an cire ɓangaren x<0; a d zangon ya faɗaɗa. Sauyin zangon na iya sa mafita ta ɓace ko ta samu, saboda haka a gwada da lissafin asali.

y-m-60-07.title: Duba mafitar da ta nemo jimlar kalmar gaba ɗaya daga dabarar jimla
y-m-60-07.topic: Jimlar jerin da kalmar gaba ɗaya: duba kalmar farko yayin nemo aₙ daga Sₙ
y-m-60-07.goal: A cikin mafitar da ta nemo kalmar gaba ɗaya daga jimlar Sₙ, gano inda aka manta da zato n≥2, duba da lambobi na zahiri, sannan ka gina dabarar jimla da kanka wadda ba ta buƙatar ware kalmar farko.
y-m-60-07.material: Ga jerin {aₙ}, jimlar kalmomin farko har zuwa ta n ita ce Sₙ = n² + 2n + 3 (n lambar halitta ce), kuma Eunwoo ya nemo kalmar gaba ɗaya kamar yadda aka nuna a ƙasa. (Yadda ake karantawa: aₙ “kalmar n-th” ce, Sₙ “jimla daga kalmar farko zuwa kalmar n-th” ce, Sₙ₋₁ kuma “jimla har zuwa kalmar (n−1)-th” ce.)
y-m-60-07.thinking.1: Duba sakamakon da lambobi na zahiri
y-m-60-07.thinking.2: Gina dabarar da ta cika sharuddan da kanka
y-m-60-07.prereq.0: Dangantaka tsakanin jimlar Sₙ da kalmar gaba ɗaya aₙ ta jerin (Sₙ jimlar kalmomin farko har zuwa kalmar n ce)
y-m-60-07.prereq.2: Wannan matakin wahala ne na wannan aiki (H3), ba aikin ajin makaranta ba, kuma yana ɗauka cewa ka kammala sashen jerin.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda a mafitar Eunwoo inda aka yi kuskure.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta sakamakon a₁ = 3 kai tsaye da ma’anar S₁ (jimlar daga kalmar farko zuwa kalmar farko).
y-m-60-07.s.s1.hint.1: Duba abin da Sₙ₋₁ yake idan aka saka n=1 cikin dabarar layi na 1.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka ga kowace lambar halitta n, aₙ = 2n + 1.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka kalmar farko ita ce a₁ = 3.
y-m-60-07.s.s1.explain: Layi na 1 yana aiki ne kawai idan n≥2. Ba a ayyana S₀ ba, don haka ba za a yi amfani da shi idan n=1 ba. Saboda haka “kowace lambar halitta n” a layi na 4 da a₁ = 3 a layi na 5 ba daidai ba ne. Kalmar farko ita ce a₁ = S₁ = 1 + 2 + 3 = 6. Lissafin layuka 2 da 3 (2n+1 ga n≥2) daidai ne. An karɓi zaɓar kowane layi daga 1, 4, ko 5.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.prompt: Sₙ = pn² + qn + r (p, q, r cikakkun lambobi ne, p≥1), S₃ = 21, kuma kalmar farko a₁ = S₁ aƙalla 1 ce. A wannan yanayin, nemo ƙimomin p biyu mabambanta waɗanda ƙimar da aka samu idan an saka n=1 cikin dabarar aₙ = Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ (ga n≥2) ta yi daidai da S₁ (wato yanayin da ba a buƙatar ware kalmar farko), ka shigar da su.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.hint.0: Lissafta Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ kai tsaye ga pn² + qn + r, ka sauƙaƙa shi zuwa kalma mai n.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo sharadin da zai sa ƙimar wannan kalma idan n=1 ta yi daidai da S₁ = p + q + r.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.ok.c1: p, q, r cikakkun lambobi ne kuma p≥1.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.fail.c1: p, q, r dole su zama cikakkun lambobi, kuma p dole ya zama aƙalla 1.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.fail.c3: S₁ = p + q + r ya gaza 1.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.ok.c4: Ƙimar dabarar ga n≥2 idan n=1 ta yi daidai da S₁.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.fail.c4: Saka n=1 cikin dabarar 2pn + (q−p) da aka samo ga n≥2 yana ba da p+q. Duba ƙimar r da ake buƙata don wannan ya yi daidai da S₁ = p+q+r.
y-m-60-07.s.s2.explain: Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ = 2pn + (q − p), kuma saka n=1 yana ba da p + q. Don wannan ya yi daidai da S₁ = p + q + r, ana buƙatar r = 0. Sai S₃ = 9p + 3q = 21, wato 3p + q = 7, kuma nau’i-nau’in cikakkun lambobin da suka cika S₁ ≥ 1 su ne (p, q) = (1, 4), (2, 1), (3, −2). Misali, idan Sₙ = 3n² − 2n, to aₙ = 6n − 5 yana aiki idan n=1 ma (a₁ = 1).
y-m-60-07.s.s3.prompt: A cikin jimloli ɗaya ko biyu, ta amfani da aƙalla ƙima guda (lamba), bayyana dalilin da ya sa ba daidai ba ne a yi amfani da aₙ = 2n + 1 ga duk n a jerin Sₙ = n² + 2n + 3 na Eunwoo.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.hint.0: Duba ƙimar Sₙ₋₁ idan n=1 a cikin aₙ = Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ na Eunwoo.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta gefe da gefe ƙimar S₁ da aka lissafa kai tsaye da ƙimar 2n+1 idan n=1.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa a₁ daidai yake da S₁ don samun 6?
y-m-60-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka nuna rashin daidaiton ta hanyar kwatanta da ƙimar 2n+1 idan n=1?
y-m-60-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka kuma ce ana iya amfani da wannan dabarar ne kawai idan n≥2?
y-m-60-07.s.s3.model.0: a₁ shi ne S₁, don haka 1 + 2 + 3 = 6 ne; amma idan aka saka n=1 cikin 2n + 1, ana samun 3, saboda haka sun bambanta. Don haka ana iya amfani da dabarar ne kawai ga n≥2, kuma dole a nemo kalmar farko dabam.
y-m-60-07.s.s3.model.1: Kalmar farko ita ce S₁ = 6. Amma idan aka saka n=1 cikin aₙ = 2n+1, ana samun 3, don haka ba daidai ba ne. Don amfani da Sₙ₋₁, dole n ya zama aƙalla 2; saboda haka a binciki n=1 dabam.
